# Independent CODE Review — `audit-cargo-packaging` (parent `ce0fb312`)

## Verdict: APPROVE

I re-derived the mechanism from the supplied bodies rather than the narrative, and checked the code against the raw receipts.

### What actually holds up

**The rename is lossless and the replay is byte-exact.** `execution/source-freeze.json` (007) lengths and the seven archived bodies (008–014) agree on 454/375/246/222/250/377/217 = 2141, matching `renames.json` (031) and `verify.nu`'s `math sum` assertion. More importantly, the staged replay reproduces the *original* result streams: `research-after-v2.stdout` (072) is `d9a4f1b0…` and `proof-after-v2.stdout` (075) is `756a8291…`, identical to `records/research-before.stdout` / `proof-before.stdout` as frozen in the snapshot (042), with the same counts (89/98/9; 619/2777/115). That is the central claim of the unit and it is measured, not asserted.

**The staging helper (021) cannot write into the repository.** Every write target is under a fresh `mktemp -d`; the only repository reads are hashes. The missing-archive case fails in `let hashes = …` *before* `mktemp`, so nothing is even created; the collision case fails on the explicit `Logical Cargo path already exists` assert. `controls/staging-v2/results.json` (040) shows both deliberate failures at status 1 with an identical 1259-file/56,517,912-byte/`7616f616…` audit-tree hash before and after, and `historical_invoked: false`. Index alignment between `$originals` and `$archives` is correct (both append the entry last, `each` preserves order), and the entry overwrite is the sole collision, gated by a prior wrapper-hash check.

**The staged layout equals the historical layout exactly, not approximately.** `staging-tests-v2.rb` (035) compares the capsule's full file set against `git ls-tree -r --name-only ce0 -- audit/<capsule>` and then every path's bytes against `git show ce0:…`. 13/90/620 with set equality simultaneously proves (a) the `.txt` files were *moved*, not duplicated, (b) `*.original.nu.txt` no longer exists in the stage, and (c) `cp --recursive` introduced nothing extra.

**The nonzero-child gap is genuinely closed, and the receipts come from the final code.** The wrappers use `complete` + `print --no-newline` on both streams + `finish $staged $result.exit_code`. `child-exit-v1.rb` (036) asserts exact stdout equality, status 77, and a stderr matching `\Astderr-no-newlineFailed historical replay retained at (…)\n\z` with `capsule/verify.nu` present (041). Crucially, the wrapper hashes in the frozen witness tree (042: `794bbec4…`, `fd64cf8a…`, `ad4154da…`) equal the reviewed wrappers (015/017/019), and the `--live` receipts at 02:16:37 (082, 085) already carry the `Failed historical replay retained at …` notice — i.e. the success *and* failure paths of the final implementation are both witnessed. Historical `--live` HEAD failures (`ce0fb312` vs `b933829c`) remain required failures, exit 1, retained directory.

**CLI/default semantics are preserved explicitly, not by luck.** Both verifiers always pass resolved `--repo`/`--siblings` so the staged child never resolves its own grandparent to `/tmp`; the reproducer retains `~/cyber/radio` / `~/cyber/hemera`. The three recorded `default_cli` cases (040) confirm `literal-revision`, expanded home paths, `fetch/full = true`, and `repo=<base>`, `siblings=<OUT>` for the fake roots. `prepare-crate` is exercised on both historical revisions with exported `Cargo.toml`/`Cargo.lock`/`src/main.rs` compared to `git show`, and every `cyber-bao` file compared allowing only the function's own `path = "../../hemera/rs"` → `version = "=0.3.1"` substitution.

**The Git-consumer differential is causally controlled.** One `--shared` bare clone serves both arms through one `file://` URL; the candidate commit is built in a separate `GIT_INDEX_FILE` (so the real index/refs are untouched) from `read-tree ce0` plus an allowlist that is asserted equal to `git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all` — a stray edit anywhere raises. `diff-tree ce0..candidate` equals that allowlist, and the `ls-tree -r` lines outside `audit/` and `.claude/tasks/` are *byte-identical* (4419 paths), which is a stronger statement than "manifests and locks unchanged". Parent reproduces the duplicate warning in all four commands (049, 052, 055, 058); candidate emits none (061, 064, 067, 070). The external witness manifest is identical at all three observation points (044). Reader stdout is `ccb67963…` in all four runs and equals the frozen historical control (054/057/066/069). 63 source tuples equal; three-node graph with `features: []`.

**Metadata normalization is structural and auditable.** `metadata-v1.rb` (038) walks parsed JSON, gates exact-ID substitution on an allowed key set (correctly propagating `key` through arrays so `resolve.nodes[].dependencies[0]` and `packages[].dependencies[].source` both land in-policy), raises on ambiguous prefixes and on any unexpected unnormalized path except the shared frozen `reader_probe.rs`. 34 substitutions per arm (045/096), then full structural equality — covering features, versions, `rust_version`, dependency requirements and `deps[].pkg`. `verify.nu` (098) re-derives each substitution from the raw stdout rather than trusting the report.

**Scope discipline is honest.** `-Dwarnings`, jobs=2, incremental=0, isolated Cargo homes/targets, local-only acquisition with the recorded Hemera `insteadOf` rewrite; no production Rust, lock, version, license, BAO API or Kadek pin change; prior broad gates explicitly unrefreshed; no release/tag/publication claim.

### Blockers

None that I can substantiate from the supplied material.

## Advice (non-blocking)

- **Tie the metadata maps to validated identities.** `verify.nu` checks `exact_map`/`path_prefix_map` only for self-consistency; `metadata-v1.rb` is the only place asserting that the checkout prefix ends with the arm's 7-char rev and that the IDs carry the pinned rev. Add to `verify.nu`: each `exact_map` key must contain the independently verified arm revision (`$base` / `$snap.candidate`), and each `path_prefix_map` key must start with the recorded arm directory. Otherwise a mistaken map could collapse two genuinely different paths to one token. Source-tuple and `ls-tree` equality already cover real drift, so this is defence-in-depth.
- **Make `stage` complete by construction.** It verifies the *declared* manifests exist as `.txt` but never that the capsule contains no *undeclared* `Cargo.toml.txt`. A future capsule gaining an eighth archived manifest would stage silently incomplete; today only the external 13/90/620 set-equality control catches that. Assert inside `stage` that the capsule's `**/Cargo.toml.txt` set equals `$manifests` mapped.
- **Handle a signalled child.** `finish [staged: record, status: int]` will type-error if `$result.exit_code` is null (your own v2 attempt recorded exactly that null signal exit). It fails safe — non-zero exit, directory retained, no `rm` — but the retention notice is lost. `$result.exit_code | default 1` restores the diagnostic.
- **Document the buffering regression.** `complete` suppresses live output; the slice reproducer prints progress and runs for minutes, so it now appears silent and loses stdout/stderr interleaving. Harmless for the two JSON-emitting verifiers; worth a line in the README for `reproduce.nu`.
- **Flag the new inversion of dependency direction.** Three historical capsules now `use ../2026-10-13-audit-cargo-packaging/replay.nu`, i.e. older evidence depends on a newer capsule. Moving, renaming or compressing the 2026-10-13 directory silently breaks all three historical entry points. State that constraint in each affected capsule or in `README.md` under a "do not relocate" note.
- **The measured witness is not the merge tree.** `e22c5b47` predates `verify.nu`, `pair/`, `controls/`, `files.json`, `raw-records.json`, `final-paths.json` and `candidate.bundle`; the zero-warning result therefore attaches to that commit, not to what will be merged. The `--live` basename guard plus `final-paths.json` equality is the right mitigation — please run it against the actual merge commit (the brief already assigns final merge to the parent), since none of the added evidence files were supplied to me for a basename check.
- **Minor epoch hygiene.** `controls/staging-v2` was captured at 02:15:52, ~33 s before the frozen snapshot; its conclusions transfer (they depend only on the entry file's presence and the `.original.nu.txt` restoration), but binding each control record to the frozen wrapper SHA would remove the inference.
- **Keep the warning claim worded as it is.** With `RUSTFLAGS=-Dwarnings`, "zero compiler warnings" is partly tautological; the substantive, defensible claim is zero *Cargo* warnings across the four enumerated commands, which is how `results.json` and the README already phrase it.
- **The deferred general guard remains the real defect class.** `audit/`-only basename guarding will not catch a future absolute or repo-escaping `path =` dependency in a sibling manifest. Declining the cleanup is defensible; a cheap tracked-manifest guard still looks cheaper than rediscovering this from a downstream consumer.

**Not verified here** (indexed omissions, not read): the new capsule's `files.json` / `raw-records.json` / `final-paths.json`, `pair/candidate.bundle`, binary carriers, whole historical capsule bodies. `verify.nu` reads all of them, so its end-to-end execution is asserted by its recorded receipts, not independently reproduced in this review. No release, rung, last-tag or broad-gate conclusion follows from this approval.
